scope: Deep adjacent-theme stock screen across US, Hong Kong/China and Malaysia. Research/content only; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
macroGate: The Aug 24 Macro Board remains a quality split: industrial/power capex is strong, but the long end is restrictive and CCC credit stress is worsening at the margin. New ideas must therefore have real orders/backlog, credible cash generation or customer-funded capacity, manageable leverage and a differentiated bottleneck rather than theme overlap.
repoCorrections: Southern Cable, Dongfang Electric and DIALOG Group were already present in data/ideas.json and are not counted as new discoveries.
Ranhill Utilities remains a watch candidate, not a core promotion, after reviewing profit quality, leverage/regulatory-return and capex questions.
No genuinely new Malaysia core name cleared the quality bar in this pass.

approvedResearchPromotions.theme: AI/data-centre connectivity + industrial networking + physical AI
approvedResearchPromotions.thesis: Belden is a differentiated way to own the physical networking layer beneath AI data centres and industrial automation without requiring a single-chip or single-optical-component bet. Q2 2026 record revenue, orders and book-to-bill show that the theme is converting into current demand rather than remaining narrative-only.
evidence: Q2 2026 revenue reached about $750m, up 12% year over year and 8% organically.
Adjusted EPS rose 24% to $2.34.
Record orders reached about $836m, up 19%, with book-to-bill of 1.11.
Management said AI-data-centre investment is beginning to appear in the order book and highlighted physical-AI demand in factories and distribution centres.
Valuation is materially less duration-sensitive than many high-multiple optical and AI-infrastructure leaders.
risks: AI/data-centre revenue contribution remains early and is not separately disclosed.
Industrial demand can weaken if broad capex slows.
approvedResearchPromotions.nextWork: Quantify AI/data-centre order mix, industrial networking margin profile, RUCKUS synergies and post-acquisition leverage path.

approvedResearchPromotions.thesis: The power-reliability adjacency is now directly investable: large hyperscale customers are ordering backup generation at scale, turning reliability around the grid bottleneck into contracted demand rather than a theoretical future theme.
evidence: Q2 sales rose 11% to about $1.17bn and commercial/industrial sales rose 29% to about $556m.
Data-centre backlog reached roughly $1.6bn after about $1bn of additional orders since the prior update.
The backlog excludes committed volumes from a newly signed second hyperscale customer.
Generac is expanding large-megawatt generator packaging and production capacity to serve this demand.
risks: Residential-generator cyclicality can dilute the cleaner data-centre thesis.
Current data-centre order growth may normalize after the initial hyperscaler buildout wave.
approvedResearchPromotions.nextWork: Separate hyperscale backlog, margins and delivery timing from residential earnings; compare valuation and cash conversion with POWL, ETN and VRT.

approvedResearchPromotions.thesis: Amkor is a stronger Power Stack expression of memory scarcity than simply buying commodity memory beta because advanced packaging and test capacity are required to turn HBM and accelerators into usable AI systems. Customer prepayments and long-term partnerships provide unusually strong validation of the bottleneck.
evidence: Q2 2026 sales reached a record about $1.90bn, up 26% year over year.
NVIDIA signed a $1.5bn multi-year advanced-packaging/development agreement with a prepayment to support US capacity.
TSMC signed a 10-year partnership under which it will procure advanced packaging and testing services from Amkor in Arizona.
The combination of HBM, heterogeneous integration and advanced test capacity is becoming a system-level AI infrastructure constraint.
risks: Heavy capacity build means current free-cash-flow conversion is weak/negative.
The company issued $1bn of convertible notes in April, so financing discipline still matters in a high-rate regime.
Semiconductor packaging remains cyclical despite the AI mix shift.
approvedResearchPromotions.nextWork: Model Arizona capex, customer prepayment economics, HBM/AI mix, free-cash-flow inflection and dilution from convertibles.

approvedResearchPromotions.theme: HBM thermo-compression/hybrid bonding + photonics + AI-server SMT
approvedResearchPromotions.thesis: ASMPT is the strongest genuinely new Hong Kong/China candidate because one platform touches three emerging AI bottlenecks at once: HBM advanced packaging, optical/photonics assembly and AI-server manufacturing equipment.
evidence: Q1 bookings were about HK$5.67bn, up 71.6% year over year and the highest in four years.
Q1 revenue was about HK$3.97bn, up 32% year over year.
A key memory customer adopted ASMPT's flux-based thermo-compression-bonding tool for HBM4 16H sampling and is qualifying the fluxless process.
Photonics revenue increased roughly five-fold year over year, 1.6T transceiver solutions received bulk orders and AI-server demand drove record SMT bookings.
The company announced significant wins for more than 50 chip-to-substrate TCB tools in late July.
risks: Valuation remains demanding despite a sharp correction from the 52-week high.
CEO transition and strategic review of the SMT segment add execution uncertainty.
Semiconductor equipment remains cyclical and customer qualification can be lumpy.
approvedResearchPromotions.nextWork: Update valuation after the latest results, quantify HBM/photonics order conversion and assess the SMT strategic review before raising conviction further.

tacticalCandidates.thesis: Refined-product scarcity and rerouting can raise tonne-mile demand and product-tanker economics even when the crude-price signal becomes less clean.
evidence: Q2 average TCE rose to about $52,661/day from $25,569/day a year earlier.
Asian light/middle-distillate availability remains far below pre-conflict norms and Singapore gasoil margins remain exceptional.
Hormuz traffic remains severely impaired, preserving rerouting and logistics optionality.
risks: Current charter economics are crisis-driven and can mean-revert quickly.
Shipping is cyclical and fleet sales/newbuild decisions complicate through-cycle comparisons.

tacticalCandidates.thesis: Chinese state-linked tanker capacity can benefit from rerouted Gulf/Asia energy flows and higher freight rates, but SOE governance, cyclicality and capital allocation reduce quality versus the core queue.

watchNotPromoted.reason: Johor water scarcity is a real data-centre bottleneck, but recent profit quality included a material matching-grant contribution while leverage, capex and regulated-return economics still need proof.
Strategic optoelectronics/packaging exposure and net cash are attractive, but recent revenue/earnings remain weak and the market already prices a recovery.
Machine vision is exactly the right robotics/automation adjacency, but the valuation already discounts substantial recovery and AI upside.
Optical fundamentals are excellent, but current free-cash-flow conversion is weak relative to accounting profit; wait for the working-capital/capex bridge.
Optical scarcity is real, but valuation remains high and recent hedge-fund selling creates entry opportunity only if orders remain intact while the multiple compresses.

themeFindings.summary: AI clusters create value not only for generation and grid capacity but for backup generation, UPS, switchgear, voltage control, power conditioning and service. Generac's hyperscaler backlog is direct commercial validation.

Reported AI-server price inflation tied to memory costs plus customer-funded advanced-packaging capacity shows that HBM, thermo-compression bonding, packaging and test are now system-level AI bottlenecks. AMKR and ASMPT are the preferred research expressions from this pass.

With the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve near a late-1982 level, an eventual post-crisis refill cycle could support domestic barrels, storage, pipelines and Gulf Coast logistics after the immediate conflict premium fades.

US-Canada tariff volatility raises the value of existing domestic electrical/industrial capacity and qualification. Prefer suppliers with installed capacity and balance-sheet strength rather than debt-funded greenfield projects.

Do not manufacture a social signal; today's actionable evidence comes from official company releases and current shipping/macro reporting.
researchConclusion: The deep screen broadens Power Stack from generation/grid into the reliability, networking and packaging layers around AI. BDC and GNRC are the strongest fresh US quality candidates; AMKR is a higher-capex HBM/packaging expression; ASMPT is the strongest genuinely new Hong Kong/China candidate. STNG is a tactical refined-product logistics satellite, not a core compounder. No genuinely new Malaysia core name clears the bar today; re-review existing DIALOG instead of forcing another ticker.
